'''Overseer''' was the title given to a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] instructor, training multiple [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Overseers were often [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], but holding that rank was not a requirement. Some of them were lower-ranking Sith who showed a talent for instruction.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sith Titles}}</ref> They were helped in their task by junior instructors known as Assistant Overseers.<ref name="Sith Hierarchy">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Learning from the Best|Korriban}}</ref> Some Overseers such as Overseer [[Ardran]] even took up their own [[Ardran's apprentice|apprentices]].
